author: Sylin Labs
name: Koan Semantic Search API
description: A Koan web API with semantic search: [Embedding] on an Entity, save-time vector indexing into SqliteVec, and a ranked /api/articles/search endpoint over a local Ollama embedding model. Ready to run.

manualInstructions.text:
Prerequisite: Ollama running locally with an embedding model, e.g.:
  ollama pull nomic-embed-text

Run it:
  dotnet run

Then save two articles and search by meaning:
  Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://localhost:5000/api/articles -ContentType application/json -Body '{"title":"Sourdough feeding","body":"daily flour and water"}'
  Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:5000/api/articles/search?q=bread%20baking%20routine'

Working with a coding agent:
  AGENTS.md orients any agent to this application and to Koan's capability map.
